description: List the organisation's integration connections, each with the status the Integrations page shows (working, off, needs_you or stopped, with the reason and what fixes it) and safe readiness summaries. Provider credentials, secret references, raw configuration, user mappings and webhook values are never returned. Use the integrations link for OAuth or provider setup. Not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.

provider.description: Integration provider, such as GITHUB, JIRA, LINEAR or SLACK.

name: list_integrations
title: List integration connections
